alt_fuel_stations.description: Alternative fuel and EV charging stations (AFDC Station Locator), filtered by fuel, state, ZIP, network, status.

fuel_type.desc: ELEC, E85, CNG, LPG, BD, HY, LNG, RD; comma-separated for several

status.desc: E open, P planned, T temporarily unavailable, all; comma-separated for several. Without it the API returns every status: pass E for open stations only

access.desc: public, private or all. Without it the API returns both: pass public for public stations only

ev_network.desc: EV network, e.g. Tesla, ChargePoint Network

owner_type.desc: P private, T utility, FG federal, LG local, SG state, J jointly owned

utility_rates.description: Average residential, commercial and industrial electricity rates ($/kWh) of the utility serving a point (2012 data; see traps).

lat.desc: latitude, decimal degrees (the API no longer accepts an 'address')

solar_resource.description: Average daily solar resource (kWh/m2/day) by month: DNI, GHI, latitude-tilt; one row per month plus annual.

pvwatts.description: PVWatts v8 modeled PV output for a system at a point: monthly AC kWh, plane-of-array irradiance, capacity factor (or hourly values with timeframe=hourly).

array_type.desc: 0 fixed open rack, 1 fixed roof, 2 1-axis, 3 1-axis backtracking, 4 2-axis

timeframe.desc: monthly (default): 12 rows; hourly: one row per hour of the typical year (8,760 rows: ac_w, dc_w in W; poa_w_m2, dn_w_m2, df_w_m2 in W/m2; tamb_c, tcell_c; wspd_m_s; alb)
